keys.label: Transcription engine
keys.description: Which ASR engine transcribes your audio. Non-whisper engines must be compiled into the binary.

keys.label: Model
keys.description: Whisper model to load. Larger models are more accurate and slower.

keys.label: Language
keys.description: Spoken language code, or auto to detect. A comma-separated list constrains auto-detection to those languages.

keys.label: Threads
keys.description: CPU threads used for transcription.

keys.label: Model
keys.description: Parakeet model to load.

keys.label: Built-in listener
keys.description: Off when a compositor keybinding calls voxtype record instead. Requires membership of the input group.

keys.label: Push-to-talk key
keys.description: evdev KEY_* name without the prefix, e.g. SCROLLLOCK or F13.

keys.label: Mode
keys.description: Hold the key to dictate, or press once to start and again to stop.

keys.label: Input device
keys.description: Capture device. Leave on default unless dictation should be pinned to one microphone.

keys.label: Maximum recording length
keys.description: Recording stops on its own after this many seconds.

keys.label: Pause media while recording
keys.description: Pause whatever is playing for the duration of the dictation.

keys.label: Audio cues
keys.description: Play a short tone when recording starts and stops.

keys.label: Cue volume
keys.description: Volume of the start and stop tones.

keys.label: Mode
keys.description: How transcribed text reaches the focused window.

keys.label: Fall back to the clipboard
keys.description: Copy the transcript instead of dropping it when no typing method works.

keys.label: Delay before typing
keys.description: Pause before the first keystroke. Raise it if applications drop leading characters.

keys.label: Post-process command
keys.description: Shell command that receives the transcript on stdin and returns the text to type.
Opt in to the local English-only LARD model. Missing or invalid models leave the other cleanup stages available; nothing is downloaded at startup.
keys.label: LARD disfluency cleanup

keys.description: Path to the local VXDF model. By default use the model installed by voxtype setup lard in the XDG data directory.
keys.label: LARD model file

keys.description: Add punctuation, sentence boundaries, and letter casing to plain CTC output. Engines that already provide them are unchanged.
keys.label: Restore punctuation and casing

keys.description: Convert spoken names like "period" and "new line" into the characters they describe.
keys.label: Spoken punctuation

keys.description: Strip a trailing "submit" from the transcription and press Return instead.
keys.label: Say "submit" to press Enter

keys.description: Remove "uh", "um" and the rest of text.filler_words from the output.
keys.label: Drop filler words

keys.description: Remove self-corrections where a phrase is restarted by repeating a word, plus stutters and "scratch that" retractions.
keys.label: Collapse restarts and stutters

keys.description: Join fragments split off by a premature sentence boundary and add question marks to interrogatives.
keys.label: Repair sentence breaks

keys.description: Convert spoken quantities to written form ("twenty five dollars" -> "$25"). Prose-heavy words like "one" and "first" are left alone.
keys.label: Format dictated numbers
